prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1219; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on a multi-lane roadway. Insured vehicle reported contact on the rear passenger side with the adverse vehicle's front driver side. Both drivers reported as present at scene. Police report requested.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from insured. Insured states they signaled and checked mirrors before merging, then felt contact as the other vehicle moved into the same space. No injuries reported by insured. Photos of both vehicles received and added to file.

Entry 3: Claimant has retained counsel. Letter of representation received. All further contact with claimant to go through attorney's office. Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash, has sought medical evaluation, and is currently under treatment. Bodily injury reserve set pending medical records.

Entry 4: Liability review in progress. Based on available photos and insured's account, insured's vehicle appears to have initiated the lane change, but the adverse vehicle's movement is also under review. Requested dashcam footage from both parties. Comparative fault analysis not yet complete.

Entry 5: Medical records requested through claimant's counsel and authorization forms sent. Property damage estimate received for both vehicles and under review. Claim remains open. Next step: obtain police report and complete liability determination before evaluating bodily injury demand.
